chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Every oath by which the Face of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, is not intended is of no consequence, whether regarding divorce or emancipation.

key_terms.بِشَيْءٍ: of any consequence or legal effect
key_terms.عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: Mighty and Majestic, an honorific for Allah
key_terms.عِتْقٍ: emancipation or manumission of a slave
key_terms.وَجْهُ اللَّهِ: the sake of Allah and His good pleasure

ai.seo_question: When is an oath considered legally ineffective in Islam, including in divorce or emancipation?
ai.summary: This hadith states that an oath has no legal consequence if it is not made seeking Allah’s sake. It specifically applies this principle to matters such as divorce and emancipation, showing the necessity of sincerity and proper religious intention in binding oaths.
